covered_actors: overseas AI developers and service providers targeting Korean data subjects
prohibited_practices: Development of AI systems for profiling and surveillance of individuals by combining with facial recognition databases
Development of AI systems for cyberattacks or identity fraud (phishing, smishing)
Processing publicly available personal information to explicitly disadvantage identified individuals without clear overriding public interest
implementation_notes: The document explicitly states it has no legal binding force ('법적 구속력이 없음') and presents legal interpretation standards as reference guidance. It applies to overseas AI actors targeting Korean data subjects. The guide covers the full AI lifecycle (training and service stages) and is subject to periodic revision as AI law, technology, and market conditions evolve. The PIPC plans to conduct periodic pre-emptive inspections and prior adequacy reviews, and to revise the Personal Information Protection Act to align with the AI era.
